fileProtocol.controllerLockPath: required service-owned paths field, covered by requestDigest

contents: New generic team-owned Python standard-library protocol glue, examples and offline tests only; no SDK code/binary, model parameters, historical PNG, restricted payload, private host address, authentication material or copied local-references
distributionBoundary: Separate auxiliary protocol package; integration/distribution follows the controlling project's authorization and license. No public license for referenced SDK/model/restricted adapter is implied.
controlledDependency: Operator-supplied absolute local handoff directory, verified by fixed bundle-manifest SHA256 and every declared dependency before importing its standard-library adapter facade
hardwareGate: The fixed invocation must additionally contain --approved-device-window only for an actual approved window; request authorization, full timeout coverage, deadline and positive operator-pinned lock-topology binding must also hold. SDK setup is not approval.
offlineMode: --validate-only performs supported request checks, never invokes the model, exits 3 and never writes a successful result

supportedInputPolicy.prompt: A red apple on a wooden table, soft natural window light, realistic photograph

unsupportedInputs: Every other complete spec, prompt or seed is rejected before any generator subprocess, rather than running the fixed apple request and echoing a different request

lockBoundary.controllerLock: Existing exclusive-create cooperation lock owned and released/reconciled only by the outer service; bridge reads it but never acquires/deletes it
lockBoundary.boardLock: Actual target worker obtains the canonical SDK board flock and closes it for each Q request; no external or alternate lock domain
lockBoundary.requiredTopology: Private fixed-arg config pinned by SHA, bound to operator authorization, original runtime-config SHA, controller kernel-boot identity, worker identity/board-lock inventory, and an explicit reviewed separation of lock domains and shared filesystem aliases
lockBoundary.sameHost: Actual board-lock identity must be locally available and match the approved inventory; same path, aliases or same inode are rejected
lockBoundary.remoteTopology: Operator-pinned evidence only; no remote probe is performed by offline checks and no live topology verification is claimed

executionBoundary.simulation: Not implemented by this real-model bridge; no historical replay or synthetic success mode
executionBoundary.freshness: New private per-task output/control paths, adapter fresh-invocation receipt, original runtime verification and exact requested fixed parameters; historical bundle preview is never used as output
executionBoundary.privacy: Runtime config and raw logs stay outside public job artifacts; only whitelisted trace fields are published; no raw process/device addresses, private paths, auth objects or raw SDK source
executionBoundary.timeout: Outer controlled service owns the watchdog and process group; bridge and children do not detach or create new sessions
executionBoundary.publication: Complete trace validation precedes artifact publication. Same-directory fsynced temporary files use atomic non-overwriting hard-link publication and immediate temporary unlink. Native job storage must support hard links; no replace fallback is used.
executionBoundary.requestComponents: Declarations are syntax checked and bound by requestDigest; controlled service remains responsible for actual model/component manifest validation and completeness

resultTemplate: examples/result.success.template.json is non-runnable future shape only: placeholder hashes, no image, no device execution and no completed-result claim

exitCodes.0: New verified invocation and complete standard result only
exitCodes.5: Local, artifact or new-run evidence failure

offlineTests.default: 30 portable checks; one optional production-validator interoperability test is skipped unless its local source and Node are supplied

optionalInterop.classification: Temporary synthetic simulation file-contract fixture only; no model, device, SDK or generator subprocess
